Name: Deven Supercriticals
Description:
At Deven Supercriticals, we’ve spent over two decades pioneering Supercritical Fluid (SCF) technology—engineering sustainable solutions across industries from textiles to natural extracts.

Our flagship innovation, SUPRAUNO, is a globally patented, waterless dyeing technology that transforms textile manufacturing. It’s the first in the world to enable the use of conventional dyes and tri-chrome recipes in supercritical CO2, dyeing a wide range of fabrics—Cotton, Polyester, Nylon, Viscose, Silk, Linen, Acrylic, and their blends. 

SUPRAUNO eliminates the need for salt in cotton dyeing and reduction clearing in polyester, cuts auxiliary chemical use by up to 90%, and reduces dyeing batch times—cutting energy loads by 67% and water usage by 76%. The result? Vibrant fabrics, minimal environmental impact, and a significantly lower Effluent Treatment Plant (ETP) burden.

We’ve delivered 27 SCF plants worldwide, including exports to Hungary, Malaysia, and Sri Lanka, and have been selected as innovators for global sustainability efforts like Fashion for Good.

If you're building for a greener planet or want to explore SUPRAUNO—we're here to collaborate.

By combining technology with indigenous knowledge systems, we help communities access premium markets while ensuring forests become more economically valuable standing than cleared.
Today, The Open Field works across multiple forest value chains with farmer groups, women-led collectives, hospitality brands, ethical sourcing partners, and ecosystem institutions. Our work spans climate resilience, regenerative livelihoods, traceable sourcing, restoration-linked enterprise development, and decentralized rural infrastructure.
We envision a future where forests are not extraction zones, but thriving economic ecosystems led by the communities that protect them.

Description:
For decades, the Western Ghats held what nobody came back for.

Foreign companies extracted Karnataka's finest granite through the mid-twentieth century. They took the export-grade slabs, the premium cuts, and left everything else scattered across farmers' land. That material has sat there since. Abandoned by circumstance.

Well, Green Rock Innovates it.

Through precision-engineered processing and a technology-led supply chain, we convert these historically abandoned rock deposits into IS 383 certified construction aggregates — sand, fine aggregate, coarse aggregate — the materials that account for 60 to 75 percent of every cubic metre of concrete poured in India.

We operate through our own distribution application, connecting certified material directly to national highways, PSU infrastructure projects, and construction programmes across southern India.

The rock was already here. We built the system to use it.
Holders of Karnataka's first Waste Rock Royalty Recycle Permit. Bureau Veritas audited. MORTH certified. DPIIT recognised. Shaping the future of construction in India through technology and precision materials innovation.

EcoFresh is recognized by DPIIT (Ministry of Commerce & Industry), backed by the Ministry of Education's (MoE) Innovation Cell, and incubated at IIITDM Jabalpur, IIT Ropar TBIF, and Ratan Tata Maharashtra State Skills University (iSpark, Govt. of Maharashtra).
